localChanges: When a city's food store runs out, you're told what it cost, as in Civ1: "Food storage exhausted in Rome! Settlers lost." when the city loses Settlers it feeds, and "Food storage exhausted in Rome! Famine feared." when it shrinks instead (closes #969, closes #975).

log: A starving city now loses one Settlers only once its food store runs out, as in Civ1. Until then it eats into the store and loses nothing. Before, its Settlers were disbanded as soon as it was short of food, as many as it took (civ-clone/web-renderer#969).
A city that shrinks from famine now starts again with an empty food store, as in Civ1, rather than one still short from the famine (civ-clone/web-renderer#969).
A city that starves away no longer completes what it was building that turn (civ-clone/web-renderer#975).
A Wonder lost with its city no longer counts towards your score, in games saved before this was fixed (civ-clone/web-renderer#975).
In a game saved before this fix, a Wonder completed in a city that had already starved away is now shown as lost and no longer does anything for that city's player (civ-clone/web-renderer#975).
